$comment: The tide (docs/design/holding.md "Kesh"): fullOfTide is the fixed local hour (HH:MM) at which each tide begins, in timeZone (an IANA name), chosen for the server's players (GAME DESIGN). Computed with Intl.DateTimeFormat in that zone, so the full stays at the same wall-clock hour across a daylight-saving change and a tide is 23 or 25 h on those two days.
